THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Dirt Cake Cookie Creami

Black-cocoa protein Creami with a HighKey cookie mix-in, homemade fudge, and Oreo cookie dirt. Approximately 325 calories and 38g protein for the whole finished pint with Nurri 2% (filmed).

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min rest + 24 hr freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~325 cal | ~38g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Amounts and nutrition refer to one complete finished pint.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1 cup ultra-filtered 2% milk (filmed: Nurri 2%)
  • 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (label: 60 calories / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum
  • Pinch of salt

Ingredients — continued

  • 1 tbsp Anthony’s black cocoa
  • 1 HighKey Original sandwich cookie, for the mix-in
  • 1 tbsp Ghirardelli Dutch-process unsweetened cocoa, for the fudge
  • 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple-flavored syrup, for the fudge
  • Oreo dust measured to 40 calories using your package label

Allergens: milk, wheat, soy.

You want a dirt-cake Cookie Creami with black cocoa, homemade fudge, and Oreo dirt.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND. Blend milk, whey, sweetener, guar gum, salt and Anthony’s black cocoa until smooth. No added vanilla in this flavor.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Freeze the pint upright and level for 24 hours. Rest on the counter for 5 minutes.
  3. 3.SPIN. Process on Regular Ice Cream.
  4. 4.MIX IN. Add one HighKey Original sandwich cookie after the first spin, then Respin without added liquid. Repeat if needed for your texture.
  5. 5.MAKE THE FUDGE. Stir 1 tbsp Ghirardelli Dutch-process cocoa with 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple-flavored syrup until smooth.
  6. 6.FINISH. Spoon the fudge over your scoops and finish with Oreo dust measured to 40 calories on your package label.

Keys to success

  • Freeze upright and level for 24 hours, within the machine’s fill line.
  • Follow your Creami model’s safety and processing instructions.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level. Spin and finish when ready to eat.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Follow the Creami machine guidance for storage and reprocessing.

Estimated nutrition

~325 cal | ~38g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint.

Approximately 325 calories and 38g protein for the whole finished pint with Nurri 2% (filmed), including HighKey cookie, homemade fudge, and Oreo dust. With Fairlife 2%: about 295 calories and 31g protein. Rounded totals ≈324 → about 325 cal / approximately 38g protein. Ultra-filtered milk brands are not nutritionally interchangeable — use your carton’s label.
